theorems.name: Submission.dorag_th_radial_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ξ : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ (r / 2), ζ x = 1) ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ closedBall ξ r ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / r
